captions.detailed: This 3D model features a modern smoothie blender with a matte black base, a transparent frosted-glass pitcher, and a black lid with a top handle. It includes a rectangular black side handle on the pitcher and a small rotary dial on the side of the base along with two independent orange function buttons. The internal blade spins continuously at the bottom of the pitcher, the dial rotates continuously, and the two buttons function as prismatic sliders.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a smoothie blender with a matte black motor base and a transparent frosted pitcher. The model must include a continuous rotary dial on the side, two prismatic function buttons, and a continuous spinning blade assembly at the bottom of the pitcher.
captions.factory: The base is constructed using a lofted or extruded box with chamfered upper edges. The pitcher is made from a hollowed, tapered rectangular extrusion combined with a separate handle and lid. The rotary dial is created using a cylinder and a rectangular indicator tab, while the push buttons are simple boxes. The internal blade is modeled with crossed rectangular plates. Joints are defined for the continuous rotation of the dial and blade, and prismatic limits are set for the two push buttons.
